# STM32G474RET6 (LQFP-64) pin assignment (generated by `python -m board.generate`)

AF numbers are from the author's knowledge of DS12288, not from a downloaded datasheet. LQFP-64 pad numbers are recalled and UNVERIFIED (the netlist connects by pin NAME). Rows marked **verify** must be confirmed in STM32CubeMX before layout.

| signal | pin | LQFP-64 pad (unverified) | function | AF | confidence | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SERVO_TX | PB10 | 30 | USART3_TX | AF7 | high | servo bus TX -> 74AHCT1G126 A |
| SERVO_RX | PB11 | 33 | USART3_RX | AF7 | high | servo bus RX <- 74LVC1G125 Y |
| SERVO_DIR | PB14 | 36 | USART3_DE (RTS/DE, DEM=1) | AF7 | **verify** (medium) | hardware driver-enable: high during TX; drives both buffer OEs. If not available, use PB14 as GPIO toggled in the TC interrupt |
| LOG_TX | PA9 | 43 | USART1_TX | AF7 | high | debug log; USART1 PA9/PA10 is also a ROM-bootloader port |
| LOG_RX | PA10 | 44 | USART1_RX | AF7 | high |  |
| USB_DM | PA11 | 45 | USB_DM | USB (fixed pin) | **verify** (medium) | USB FS pins are fixed; confirm in RM0440 whether an AF selection is needed (CubeMX does it) |
| USB_DP | PA12 | 46 | USB_DP | USB (fixed pin) | **verify** (medium) | internal DP pull-up, no external 1.5k |
| CAN_RXD | PB12 | 34 | FDCAN2_RX | AF9 | **verify** (medium) | FDCAN1 is avoided: PA11/12 clash with USB, PB8 is BOOT0 (CAN RXD idles high -> would boot ROM) |
| CAN_TXD | PB13 | 35 | FDCAN2_TX | AF9 | **verify** (medium) |  |
| CAN_STB | PC9 | 41 | GPIO output | GPIO | high | TCAN1462 standby; 10k pull-up = standby at reset |
| ISENSE_ADC | PA0 | 12 | ADC12_IN1 | analog | high | INA240 output via 100R/1nF |
| VSERVO_ADC | PA1 | 13 | ADC12_IN2 | analog | high | servo-rail divider 100k/15k |
| NTC_ADC | PC0 | 8 | ADC12_IN6 | analog | **verify** (medium) | board NTC |
| VIN_ADC | PC1 | 9 | ADC12_IN7 | analog | **verify** (medium) | protected 12 V divider 100k/15k |
| LED1_DRV | PB0 | 24 | TIM3_CH3 | AF2 | high | status LED (PWM-able) |
| LED2_DRV | PB1 | 25 | TIM3_CH4 | AF2 | high | status LED (PWM-able) |
| SERVO_PWR_EN | PC6 | 38 | GPIO output | GPIO | high | firmware enable of servo power (AND-ed with e-stop) |
| ESTOP_SENSE | PC7 | 39 | GPIO input / EXTI7 | GPIO | high | e-stop loop state, high = loop closed |
| VBUS_SENSE | PC8 | 40 | GPIO input | GPIO | high | USB VBUS present (divider 10k/20k) |
| SWDIO | PA13 | 49 | SWDIO | AF0 (reset default) | high |  |
| SWCLK | PA14 | 50 | SWCLK | AF0 (reset default) | high |  |
| SWO | PB3 | 56 | TRACESWO | AF0 | high | PB3 is also JTDO |
| OSC_IN | PF0-OSC_IN | 5 | RCC_OSC_IN (HSE) | system | high | 24 MHz crystal |
| OSC_OUT | PF1-OSC_OUT | 6 | RCC_OSC_OUT (HSE) | system | high |  |
| NRST | PG10-NRST | 7 | NRST | system | high | 100 nF to GND + reset button |
| BOOT0 | PB8-BOOT0 | 61 | BOOT0 | system | high | 10k pull-down + BOOT button; nSWBOOT0/nBOOT0 option bytes decide whether the pin is sampled |

Pins deliberately avoided:

- PB4: UCPD1_CC2 dead-battery pull-down active at reset (also NJTRST)
- PB6: UCPD1_CC1 dead-battery pull-down active at reset
- PB8: shared with BOOT0 - only BOOT0 use
- PC14/PC15: LSE pins, weak drive
- PC13: RTC/tamper domain, weak drive (<3 mA)

Power pins: VDD x4, VBAT -> +3V3 (100 nF each + 4.7 uF); VDDA, VREF+ -> +3V3A via ferrite (1 uF + 10 nF + 100 nF); VSS x4, VSSA -> GND.
